title: [finding] The director charter has no split-seat provision — on 2026-09-06 two director summons ran concurrently, duties divided by maintainer instruction rather than by any written rule
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #16, `session_01Qgk9RnMDLdpz4U8GGRSvHG`, GitHub `os-steve`) as a `finding` for the `domain:skills` lane, per the shift-report rule that a missing principle goes to that lane as a finding. ⛔ No `domain:*` set — that is the skills seat's own triage (findings in that lane self-triage). ⛔ Not dispatchable as filed; the skills seat grades it.

## What happened (measured on the seat post, objectstack #12708)

- Summon #15 of the director seat (`session_01TezFG8ZMrNH6n5VTNpPpdH`, `os-zhuang`) was seated 2026-09-05T10:33Z and was still producing at 2026-09-06T03:48Z (contract-review batch #6, comment 5556716642). No closing brief exists.
- At 2026-09-06T03:34Z the maintainer opened a second session with `/pm-dispatch director` 「项目总监开始决裁」. That session (summon #16) read the mutex and, finding no closing brief and a live incumbent, asked the maintainer; the answer was 「已结束,我接管开第 16 场」.
- In the same window the maintainer told summon #15, verbatim as that seat recorded it: 「决裁不需要你处理」 (03:36Z, quoted in 5556716642).
- Net effect: two director sessions active on one seat, with the four charter duties divided by the maintainer's two utterances — summon #15 keeps duty one (contract-review audit and batches) and its landings; summon #16 takes duties two, three and four (decision rulings, the awaiting-maintainer ledger, the governed-merge audit). Recorded on the seat post at 5556825666.

## The gap

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` and the SKILL.md 〈入口与角色〉 mutex rules describe exactly one occupant per seat: the four readings, the closing brief as the release, 「维护者明示召唤是仲裁:有简报径直坐席;无简报才走保守确认,确认终止即坐席」. Nothing says what a seat does when arbitration produces a **split** rather than a takeover:

1. which of the four duties each session owns, and where that is written so the other session (and the next one) can read it — today it lives in one session's opening marker and the other session's batch comment;
2. the seat post's single-occupant fields (`当前 PM` 三元, title state word `🟢 <login>`, assignee) — whether they carry two occupants or one;
3. the write-surface fence between the two — this summon fenced itself off every `needs:contract-review` carrier and every landing the incumbent lists, but that is this summon's judgement, not a rule;
4. the closing order — whether a duty subset closes with its own brief, and which brief releases the seat.

The 一座位一车道双射 invariant (「域 X 谁管、PM Y 管什么,各恰好一个答案」) is what this violates on its face; the charter's own remedy for load, 拆席 (「车道可按仓分席」), is written for `domain:*` lanes by repo, not for the director's four duties.

## What is asked

The skills seat decides between (a) a one-paragraph split-seat provision in `director.md` (a second summons declares its duty subset in its opening marker, edits only its own block of the seat post, and touches nothing the incumbent's latest ledger lists as in flight; each subset closes with its own brief; the seat is released when no block remains), or (b) a rule that the director seat is never split and a second summons must wait for the incumbent's brief or the maintainer's explicit stand-down of the incumbent. ⛔ This card recommends neither; both are consistent with what the maintainer did today, and the choice is a principle, not a patch.

Governing text: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` 〈授权与形态〉 (双射 carve-out, one seat post) and SKILL.md 〈入口与角色〉 (mutex readings, arbitration line). Dedupe: `search_issues` for the split-seat shape returned only the closed charter card #12661; the control query for #15929 hit, so the empty result is a reading.
